notes: DiscoFlate v3.60.0 — the Devices tab is rebuilt around the PUMP, not the plug. 🔌 Change outlet re-points a pump at a different plug while keeping its name, its calibration and every command that uses it — so a swapped plug no longer means relabelling hardware or recalibrating. Your pumps are at the top now; adding hardware folds away into one box per brand that owns its credentials, its scan and its results. Power strips group into a single entry with Add all.
